content.text: From Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Chuck NorrisNorris in 2015BornCarlos Ray NorrisMarch 10, 1940Ryan, Oklahoma, U.S.DiedMarch 19, 2026 (aged 86)Kauaʻi, Hawaii, U.S.Notable workCordell Walker in Walker, Texas RangerJoshua McCord in The President's Man and The President's Man 2: A Line in the SandSpouses Dianne Holechek ​​(m. 1958; div. 1989)​ Gena O'Kelley​(m. 1998)​Children5 Carlos Ray "Chuck" Norris (March 10, 1940 – March 19, 2026) was an American actor, martial artist and celebrity. He served in the United States Air Force. He became famous as a martial artist and started his own school, Chun Kuk Do. Norris was cast in several action movies, such as Way of the Dragon. He was The Cannon Group's star in the 1980s. He played Cordell Walker in the action television series Walker, Texas Ranger from 1993 to 2001. Norris was a political conservative.[1] He wrote books on Christianity. In 2007 and 2008, he campaigned for former Arkansas Governor Mike Huckabee, who was running for the Republican nomination for President in 2008. In the 2012 election he endorsed former Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich, and he supported Donald Trump in 2016.[2] Norris also is a columnist for the conservative website WorldNetDaily. Norris during a meeting with USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) commanding officer Captain J. R. Haley, in June 2005 Chuck Norris' star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.
